integrity.first_public_date_basis: The earliest day-specific public evidence verified in this run is the OEIS hyperdeterminant identification dated 2004-03-15. The classical 1992 GKZ paper is older, but no day-level public-source date was verified and no date was invented.
integrity.formula_basis: Ottaviani-Sodomaco-Ventura Section 3.2 reproduces the GKZ exponential generating function, exact coefficient formula, and Frobenius ED degree d!.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: Kohn's archival source is math.AG and lists MSC 14J70, 14M15, 14C05, 15A69; the modern full-text degree source is also math.AG.

scientific_limitations: Complex Segre varieties in the standard embedding only.
The full valuation is not determined in the residue class d congruent to 1 modulo 4.
The ED-degree comparison uses the Frobenius inner product rather than the generic ED degree.
The original 1992 hyperdeterminant article was not available for claim-level full-text inspection; an unindexed older arithmetic corollary remains possible.
title: A dyadic phase law for hypercubical hyperdeterminant degrees
